plan.title: Island diorama
plan.summary: A low-poly island diorama with rocks, water, a campfire, a night sky and an orbiting camera.

steps.title: Island mesh
steps.instructions: A displaced, faceted island with a sandy material; register ctx['objects']['island'].

steps.title: Rocks
steps.instructions: Rocks ray-cast onto the island; register ctx['objects']['rocks'].

steps.title: Water
steps.instructions: A water plane with a transmissive blue material; register ctx['objects']['water'].

steps.title: Sun and camera
steps.instructions: A sun and a 35 mm camera framing the island; register ctx['objects']['sun'] and ctx['objects']['camera'].

steps.title: Campfire
steps.instructions: A small campfire on the island: a ring of logs, an emissive flame and a point light inside it.

steps.title: Night sky and distant lights
steps.instructions: A night world, glowing buildings on the far shore and compositor bloom.

steps.title: Palm trees
steps.instructions: Geometry-nodes trees scattered over the island, with Density and Seed inputs.

steps.title: Camera orbit
steps.instructions: Animate s4's camera on a slow orbit around the island over frames 1-240 (looping, linear), always looking at the campfire's flame, keeping the rocks, the trees and the far shore in frame; set the frame range.

round2.critique: The orbit was keyed on a new camera instead of s4's chimera_camera, and it looks at the origin, not the campfire's flame.

items.notes: s5 to s7 are in today's format (whole scripts, no handoff); s5's flame object is made by its own helper. The round-2 part carries a turntable script as last round's result.

plan.title: Perfume studio
plan.summary: A perfume bottle product shot: backdrop, lights, camera, the bottle, a material preview row, a turntable and background props, then the look.

steps.title: Backdrop
steps.instructions: A curved white backdrop with a bevelled corner; register ctx['objects']['backdrop'].

steps.title: Lights
steps.instructions: Key, fill and rim area lights in a lights collection.

steps.title: Camera
steps.instructions: A 50 mm camera, the scene camera; register ctx['objects']['camera'].

steps.title: Bottle and materials
steps.instructions: The perfume bottle, its gold cap, glass and gold materials.

steps.title: Material preview row
steps.instructions: A row of material test spheres for the art director (metal, glass, rubber, neon, wax, car paint), with labels.

steps.title: Turntable spin
steps.instructions: A turntable that spins the product 360 degrees over 120 frames.

steps.title: Background props
steps.instructions: Props behind the set, slightly out of focus: a bookshelf, a ceramic mug and a short garden fence.

steps.title: Look and focus
steps.instructions: Set EEVEE with AgX and the 'AgX - Punchy' look, a compositor Glare (Bloom) on the highlights, and depth of field on s3's camera focused on s4's bottle at f/2.8.

round2.critique: Bloom must go through the compositor's Glare node on its own tree (scene.compositing_node_group), and the depth of field was missing.

items.notes: s4 to s7 are in today's format: whole scripts with their own lights and cameras, so the worker must pick s3's camera and s4's bottle by name.
